nodes.description: Caller-controlled address used as transfer sender, spender, disputer, voter and fork proposer.
Block timestamp accessed as `now`, used for dispute deadlines and voting windows.
ERC20 transfer entry point; delegates to doTransfer with msg.sender as _from.
Spends allowance and delegates to doTransfer; mutates self.allowed.
Sets allowance for a spender after zero-allowance and non-zero address checks.
Core balance-moving routine that validates, updates checkpoints and emits Transfer.
Binary search over balance checkpoints at a given block number.
Determines spendable balance, subtracting stakeAmount for staked accounts.
Pushes or overwrites the latest balance checkpoint for the current block.
Opens a dispute, charges a fee, sets deadlines and status flags.
Casts a weighted vote using the voter balance snapshotted at dispute start.
Finalizes a dispute after the minimum execution date has passed.
Creates a fork proposal dispute and charges an escalating fork fee.
Migrates the tellorContract address after a passing fork vote and delay.
Refunds or slashes fees/stakes after the dispute resolution delay; permissionless.
Recalculates disputeFee as a function of stakeAmount, stakerCount and targetMiners.
Nested allowance mapping cleared and written by approve/transferFrom.
Per-address checkpoint array storing historical balances.
StakeInfo mapping (currentStatus, startDate) for each staker.
Generic uint storage: stakeAmount, disputeFee, stakerCount, total_supply, version, etc.
Dispute structs keyed by disputeId, including tally, voted and disputeUintVars.
Request structs holding mined values, inDispute flags and apiUintVars.
Maps a dispute hash to its originating disputeId.
self.allowed[_from][msg.sender] -= _amount performed with raw arithmetic rather than SafeMath.
previousBalance - _amount and previousBalance + _amount computed with raw arithmetic inside doTransfer.
self.uintVars[stakerCount] -= 1 in unlockDisputeFee without SafeMath or underflow guard.
apiUintVars[disputeCount]-- in unlockDisputeFee without underflow protection.
Dispute deadlines written from now (now + 2 days * dispRounds, now + 7 days), making resolution time miner-influenceable.
Voting/unlock eligibility gated purely on now (now >= minExecutionDate, now - tallyDate > 1 days), a timestamp dependency.
Recipient address parameter of transfer/transferFrom/doTransfer.
Token amount parameter used throughout the transfer path.
Source address parameter of transferFrom/doTransfer.
Spender address parameter of approve.
Account whose historical balance is queried.
Block number used for the checkpoint search in balanceOfAt.
Request identifier parameter of beginDispute.
Mined timestamp parameter of beginDispute.
Index of the disputed miner slot, also drives the fee calculation.
Dispute identifier parameter of vote/tallyVotes/updateTellor/unlockDisputeFee.
Vote direction flag in vote.
Proposed fork address parameter of proposeFork.
Cached balance of _from/_to inside doTransfer.
Storage pointer to the balance checkpoint array in balanceOfAt.
Balance-at-dispute-start used as voting weight in vote.
Disputed miner address derived from the minersByValue array.
Computed dispute fee transferred to the contract in beginDispute.
Cached dispute tally read in tallyVotes.
Number of dispute rounds used for fees and deadlines.
Storage pointer to the reported miner's StakeInfo.
Loop-local dispute identifier used when refunding fees.

edges.reason: msg.sender is forwarded as the _from address of transfer via doTransfer.
msg.sender is the spender whose allowance is debited in transferFrom.
msg.sender owns the allowance slot written by approve.
msg.sender becomes reportingParty and pays the dispute fee.
msg.sender determines voteWeight and the voted flag in vote.
msg.sender becomes reportedMiner/reportingParty and pays the fork fee.
unlockDisputeFee is permissionless and its outcome depends only on caller-supplied dispute state.
updateMinDisputeFee is externally callable by any address with no access control.
Dispute timestamps (minExecutionDate = now + 2 days * dispRounds) are derived from the block timestamp.
tallyVotes eligibility depends on now >= minExecutionDate, a pure timestamp dependency.
updateTellor requires now - tallyDate > 1 days before the contract address can be migrated.
unlockDisputeFee requires now - tallyDate > 1 days before any funds are released.
transfer delegates all value movement to doTransfer.
transferFrom calls doTransfer after debiting the allowance.
transferFrom writes self.allowed[_from][msg.sender].
Allowance is reduced with unchecked subtraction rather than SafeMath.
approve overwrites the allowance entry for msg.sender and _spender.
doTransfer reads the current balances of _from and _to via balanceOf.
doTransfer requires allowedToTrade before moving funds.
doTransfer writes new checkpoints into self.balances.
Balance subtraction/addition is performed with raw uint arithmetic.
balanceOfAt reads the checkpoint array from self.balances.
allowedToTrade inspects stakerDetails[_user].currentStatus.
allowedToTrade subtracts uintVars[stakeAmount] from the balance.
updateBalanceAtNow pushes or rewrites the latest checkpoint.
beginDispute collects the dispute fee through TellorTransfer.doTransfer.
beginDispute creates and populates disputesById[disputeId].
beginDispute reads requestDetails and clears inDispute/finalValues.
beginDispute maps the dispute hash to a disputeId and tracks rounds.
The dispute deadline is computed directly from the current timestamp.
vote reads the historical balance via balanceOfAt at the dispute block.
vote updates voted, numberOfVotes and tally on disputesById.
tallyVotes mutates executed, disputeVotePassed, tallyDate and staker status.
Execution of tallyVotes is gated solely by the current timestamp versus minExecutionDate.
proposeFork charges the fork fee through TellorTransfer.doTransfer.
proposeFork writes the new fork dispute and round bookkeeping.
proposeFork registers the fork hash in disputeIdByDisputeHash.
Fork proposal deadline (now + 7 days) is derived from the block timestamp.
updateTellor bumps uintVars[version] from the dispute's newVersion.
updateTellor reads dispute flags, proposedForkAddress and tallyDate.
Migration is allowed only after now - tallyDate exceeds one day.
unlockDisputeFee returns stakes and fees through multiple doTransfer calls.
unlockDisputeFee calls updateMinDisputeFee after slashing a staker.
unlockDisputeFee mutates the reported miner's stake status and startDate.
unlockDisputeFee reads stakeAmount and decrements stakerCount.
unlockDisputeFee iterates disputesById to refund each round's fee.
stakerCount is decremented with raw arithmetic, risking underflow and desynchronised fee accounting.
apiUintVars[disputeCount] is decremented without a lower-bound check.
Fee unlocking is permitted only when now - tallyDate > 1 days.
updateMinDisputeFee writes uintVars[disputeFee] using stakeAmount, stakerCount and targetMiners.

normalization_plan.reason: The recipient parameter only exists to drive the doTransfer value movement.
The amount parameter is consumed by the unchecked balance arithmetic in doTransfer.
The source address is only meaningful inside doTransfer's balance updates.
The spender parameter is exclusively used by approve's allowance write.
The user parameter selects the checkpoint array read by balanceOfAt.
The block number parameter bounds the binary search in balanceOfAt.
The requestId parameter keys requestDetails inside beginDispute.
The timestamp parameter selects the mined value being disputed in beginDispute.
The miner index parameter drives fee selection and inDispute flags in beginDispute.
The disputeId parameter resolves the dispute chain that unlockDisputeFee pays out.
The support flag only chooses the sign of the tally update in vote.
The proposed address is hashed and stored by proposeFork as proposedForkAddress.
The cached balance is the operand of the unchecked addition/subtraction in doTransfer.
The checkpoint pointer is the storage target written by updateBalanceAtNow.
Vote weight is computed and immediately applied to the tally inside vote.
The disputed miner address is resolved from storage and stored on the new dispute in beginDispute.
The fee local is calculated and transferred out within beginDispute.
The cached tally is read and consumed only by tallyVotes.
The round counter is derived from dispute state and used for deadlines/fees in beginDispute.
The stake pointer is loaded purely to mutate or slash the reported miner's stake.
The loop identifier only indexes disputesById during the refund loop.
